context: Tests whether the agent detects and follows an existing RestAssured + Testcontainers integration-test convention rather than defaulting to different conventions such as MockMvc, MockMvcTester, or RestTestClient, when writing tests for the Register Guest use case (UC-020) whose implementation already exists.

checklist.name: Test class name pattern
checklist.description: The test class is named UC020RegisterGuestTest (matching the UC<id><PascalCaseUseCaseName>Test pattern for UC-020), or extends the existing IntegrationTestBase with an equivalent name clearly tied to the use case

checklist.name: Extends IntegrationTestBase
checklist.description: The new test class extends the existing IntegrationTestBase rather than duplicating its Testcontainers/SpringBootTest setup

checklist.name: Uses RestAssured, not MockMvc/MockMvcTester/RestTestClient
checklist.description: The test drives the API with RestAssured (given()...when()...then()) — no MockMvc, no MockMvcTester, no RestTestClient, no @AutoConfigureMockMvc, no @AutoConfigureRestTestClient import anywhere in the new test class

checklist.name: Reuses the existing UseCase annotation
checklist.description: The test uses the existing com.example.hotel.usecase.UseCase annotation rather than creating a duplicate or new annotation type

checklist.name: @UseCase on every test method
checklist.description: Every @Test method has a @UseCase annotation with id = "UC-020"

checklist.name: @UseCase scenario matches spec
checklist.description: At least one test method uses scenario = "A1: Email Already Registered" matching the alternative flow heading in the UC-020 spec

checklist.name: @UseCase businessRules matches spec
checklist.description: At least one test method includes businessRules = {"BR-020"} matching the BR-020 heading in the spec

checklist.name: Main scenario test present
checklist.description: A test registers a guest with valid, unique data and asserts a 200/success response containing the created guest's data

checklist.name: Duplicate-email test present
checklist.description: A test registers a guest, then attempts to register a second guest with the same email, and asserts a 400 response with an error message

checklist.name: No repository/service mocking
checklist.description: No Mockito imports or usage anywhere in the test class — the real GuestService/GuestRepository/database stack is exercised

checklist.name: Cleanup via JdbcTemplate, not a separate test migration
checklist.description: Test-created guest rows are cleaned up via JdbcTemplate/JdbcTestUtils in @AfterEach (matching the RestAssured/Testcontainers convention's seeding approach) rather than introducing a new Flyway test-migration seed file
